name: 13-Week Cash & Liquidity Control System
summary: A professional rolling cash-control system for businesses and finance teams that need to see liquidity pressure before it becomes a crisis.
longDescription: Don’t just forecast cash. Control the weeks that can break it. This native Google Sheets system combines source integrity, timing confidence, scenario analysis, liquidity-floor monitoring, actual-vs-forecast variance, action ownership, and forecast history in one operating workflow.
features: Base, Upside, Downside, and Stress scenarios
Minimum liquidity floor and reserve-breach visibility
Timing windows and qualitative forecast confidence
Action owners, due dates, and mitigation tracking
compatibility: Modern desktop browser is the primary workspace
Mobile supports status review and light controlled updates
No Apps Script required for core operation
boundaryNote: This is not bank-connected treasury-management software, an ERP, a universal tax or payroll calculator, enterprise FP&A, or a database-grade audit-trail system. Excel is not included in v1.0.
